purpose: Distinguish functional redundancy/equivalence from a weak-Cell-effect confound before designing Core Validation 008.

excluded_seed.reason: Core 007 evaluation boundary bug: no modes for an eval-only address; no completed canonical candidate state exists.

data_identity.rehydration_rule: Re-select the pinned source data, verify the exact manifest SHA, and regenerate frozen hidden states when frozen-hidden.pt is absent.

diagnostics: fraction of mode mismatches that retain the same final Cell owner
hidden output difference normalized by active Cell-output magnitude
logit difference normalized by Cell-induced logit magnitude
NLL regret normalized by the larger oracle/deploy Cell effect relative to the frozen foundation path

interpretation.same_owner_mode_mismatch: Exact functional equivalence under the current single-owner Cell architecture because oracle and deploy select the same mutable matrix A despite different mode labels.
interpretation.owner_mismatch: The decisive subset. Whole-model NLL must not be interpreted without normalization by Cell contribution magnitude.
interpretation.weak_effect_confound_diagnostic: Report median max(|L_oracle-L_foundation|, |L_deploy-L_foundation|) / L_foundation. A value <= 1e-4 is classified as a weak-effect regime for this bridge only.
interpretation.near_equivalent_owner_mismatch_diagnosti: For this bridge only, classify owner mismatches as behaviorally near-equivalent when both median normalized logit-route difference and median normalized NLL regret are <= 0.25 in each completed seed.

interpretation_boundary: This bridge uses already-observed Core 007 seeds and therefore cannot be a new confirmatory scientific result.
It may determine which hypothesis Core 008 should test and which metrics should replace raw mode-label accuracy.
It must not change Core 007 protocol, gates, winner, status, or scientific_decision.
A fresh hidden-state extraction is recomputation of pinned inputs, not recovery or reconstruction of missing Core 007 results.
